minutes_text:
MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LA VE RN E
  Monday, August 16, 2021

1.  The City Council  Meeting was open to the public. In an effort to keep a safe environment and to minimize the
  spread of the  COVID- 19 Virus, the City limited occupancy and required masking for those in attendance. To
  facilitate public participation for those who did not wish to attend in person, the meeting was made available
  virtually.

2.  A regular meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Hepburn at 5: 00 p. m.
3.  Council Members  present:  Mayor Tim Hepburn
  Mayor Pro Tem Muir Davis
  Council Member Robin Carder
  Council Member Wendy Lau
  Council Member Rick Crosby

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  Assistant to the City Manager JR Ranells
  City Attorney Robert L. Kress
  Assistant City Clerk Lupe Gaeta Estrella
  Public Works Director Shawn Igoe
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer
  City Engineer Cody Howing
  City Consultant ( Gold Line/ EI FD) Dan Keesey
  Bridge Design Consultant Rodrigo Toro ( KPFF)

4.  Study Session on the Gold Line  City Council met with staff and Gold Line consultants for a Study Session on
  Pedestrian  Bridge  the proposed Pedestrian  Bridge on Arrow Highway. Staff and the consultants
  reported on the pedestrian bridge and design along with a slide presentation.

  Mayor Hepburn called for public comment on this matter.

  There was one public comment  received at the  meeting.  (To hear what was
  saidduring public comment, please visit the City' s website to view the archived
  Council meeting.)

  There were two (2) public comment emails received and are attached.

  After the City Council discussion,  they directed staff to move forward with the
  pedestrian bridge project with the proposed design.

5. .  Adjournment at 6:23 p. m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  C.

  Lupe Gaeta Estrella, CMC
  Assistant City Clerk

From:  Doug Strange < dstrangerider@gmail. com>
Sent:  Sunday, August 15, 2021 8: 59 PM
To:  City Clerk
Subject:  Comments for study session regarding Pedestrian Bridge

Please include/ forward the following comment  for the study session regarding the pedestrian  bridge.

The city actively participated  in the First Mile/ Last Mile  plan  which  was approved  by Metro  in 2019.  This plan provided

recommended  improvements to Arrow Highway  and the Arrow  Highway intersections around the station.  In 2020 The city
participated  in the Multi- Modal Regional Corridor  for Arrow Highway Plan which was finalized in 2021.  This plan further refined

the recommendations  for Arrow Highway  and the  intersections around the station.  Both plans are regional in approach with a specific
focus on the areas  around  the stations,  including the proposed  location of the bridge. The recommended  improvements  in the plans
are  important because they create safe and comfortable  access  to/ from the East, West and South  of  the new station, not just the

Fairplex.

Please consider the following:
  1.  If the bridge is approved/ funded will the recommended improvements in these plans also be pursued/ implemented?
  2.  If the recommended  modifications/  improvements  from the plans  are implemented,  is the case to build a separate dedicated
  pedestrian bridge reduced?
  3.  If$ 18M becomes  available,  would it be better for all users and the long- term value/ desirability of the area, to
  modify/ improve Arrow Highway itself?

Thanks very much,  please  let me know if you have any questions.

Doug Strange
1037 Rosemary Lane, La Verne
